2) 30–40m Hands-on: prompt review, routing rules, model selection (we’ll walk them through our console + API)
3) 20–30m Load test: small burst then sustained stream to validate batching/cold-starts
4) 10m Wrap and next steps + access handoff

Tech checklist (what we will provide):
- Ephemeral staging API key (will scope to sandbox only; Rishi to create)
- Staging endpoint: https://staging.redwood-inference.com/bytewave (test path /v1/generate)
- Example curl + sample payloads for their network team
- Runbook with rollback steps (attached)

What we need from ByteWave:
- 3 sandbox users (email accounts) to pre-provision
- VPC allowlist entries (we will give exact CIDRs)
- Confirmation whether they have a proxy that rewrites headers (if yes, we’ll provide a header-preserve checklist)

I attached the allowlist template and a short runbook excerpt. Rishi — can you plan to generate the token Wed EOD and post it to the secure Drive folder (link to follow)?
